list.description: What the list is: fixtures, articles, players

count.description: How many items the design draws, or "data" when a person chose to show whatever the data holds

groupBy.description: What one card gathers several items by, when it does: date (one card per day, its matches inside). Left out when each card is one item

field.description: What the design shows, in plain words: team name, team crest, score, kickoff time

example.description: The design's placeholder for it, as drawn: "166/5", "WOMEN", "21 JULY"

required.description: true when the design is wrong without it (teams, scores); false for what it can do without (a tickets link, a crest)

must.description: What the data has to be about, from the design: the team, the competition. Data about another one does not give the need

hints.description: The design's own words that name the data: a heading, a label, a designer's note

hook.description: A hook a person already chose for this section: start from it

need.description: What the design shows as data
